build_GARetinaHead: build a GARetinaHead instance with num_classes and in_channels for object detection
init_GARetinaHead_layers: initialize the GARetinaHead cls_convs, reg_convs, conv_loc, conv_shape, and retina layers
run_forward_single: run forward_single on a feature map tensor to get cls_score, bbox_pred, shape_pred, loc_pred
review_GARetinaHead_feature_adaption: review the GARetinaHead FeatureAdaption modules that use shape predictions to adapt cls and reg features
refactor_GARetinaHead_masked_conv: refactor the GARetinaHead MaskedConv2d retina_cls and retina_reg layers to use location-based masking during inference
